archetypes.name: dyn-tempfile-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: New AST ratchet and baseline identity logic need scanner-focused review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the tempfile-dir lint scanner and baseline writer. Check occurrence assignment, malformed-baseline failures, reason preservation, and whether multiline dir= calls are ignored without hiding live findings. Also inspect CLI and Makefile wiring for consistency with existing ratchets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
